question: W and X are brothers. S is the son of X and Q. R is married to U and is the brother of Q. T and V are the children of U. P is the mother of Q and Y is the mother of X. How is T related to S?
solution:
Preparing the family tree using the following symbols,

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/787e52a1ad546ea4085b253573647acdf71f9028dc2f1a569f19eb8803e44bc1.png] 

The family tree can be drawn as per the given information,

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/7346a7b73360ddbeea715ce8a2376687f0be5001995dfe8f9f18f9f90ce261d1.png] 

Here, we can see that T is the mother's brother's child of S.

Hence, the correct answer is **"Option 3"**.
